pages.title: Video course help
pages.desc: How to open a Field Ready QHSE video course with your Gumroad licence key, low data mode, final quiz rules, certificates and the certificate check page.
pages.html:
Our video courses live in the Course Room: watch the lessons, take the final quiz and get your certificate of completion. This page explains every step.

Quick start: {ROOM_LINE} Enter the email address you bought with and the licence key from your Gumroad receipt, then press Open my course. No password and no account to create.
  • Open your course
  • Where to find your licence key
  • Bought before 25 November 2026?
  • Watching the lessons
  • Low data mode and downloads
  • Final quiz rules
  • Your certificate
  • Check a certificate
  • Sign-in problems
  • Ask us

Open your course

  1. Open the Course Room. {ROOM_LINE2}
  2. Type the email address you used at checkout.
  3. Paste your licence key (four blocks of 8 letters and numbers, for example XXXXXXXX-XXXXXXXX-XXXXXXXX-XXXXXXXX).
  4. Press Open my course. Your courses appear under My courses.

You stay signed in on that device for 7 days. On a shared or site-office computer, use Sign out when you finish.

More than one course? Each course has its own licence key. Sign in with one key, then add the others from My courses. If you bought the course bundle, one key opens every course in it.

Where to find your licence key

  • Your Gumroad receipt email. Straight after payment Gumroad emails your receipt. The licence key is shown in it. Search your inbox (and spam folder) for “Gumroad” and the course name.
  • Your Gumroad library. Go to gumroad.com/library and sign in with the email you bought with. Open the course: the licence key is shown on its page. If you have no Gumroad account yet, create one with the same email address and your purchases appear in the library.

Copy and paste the key rather than typing it. A key only opens the course it was sold with.

Bought before 25 November 2026?

Courses bought before 25 November 2026 were sold without a licence key. Ask us for an access code using the button below. We check your purchase in Gumroad and reply by email with a code like FRQ-A-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

Enter the code in the Licence key box, together with the email address you bought with. The code works only with that email address.

Ask for an access code

Watching the lessons

  • Lessons are in order on the left (on a phone: below the video). A lesson gets its tick when you have played at least 90% of it. Skipping ahead does not count.
  • Lessons marked optional are extras and are not needed for the quiz.
  • Your progress is saved on your device and in the Course Room, so you can stop at any time and continue on another device. A lesson you left part way through resumes where you stopped, with a link to start from the beginning.

Low data mode and downloads

  • Above each video you can switch between HD and Low data. Low data plays a smaller copy of the video that uses about a quarter of the mobile data. It is ideal on site, on a phone hotspot or abroad.
  • The Course Room picks Low data for you when your phone or browser reports a slow connection or data saver is switched on. You can change it at any time.
  • Each lesson can also be downloaded to keep for offline viewing and toolbox use. Downloaded videos do not tick lessons: to count towards the quiz, a lesson must be played in the Course Room.
  • Subtitles (English captions) can be switched on in the player.

Final quiz rules

  • The quiz opens when every required lesson has its tick.
  • 15 questions, multiple choice. You need 12 correct (80%) to pass.
  • You have 2 attempts. Your answers are marked when you submit.
  • If you don’t pass the first time, the Course Room shows which questions were wrong (not the right answers), so you can re-watch those lessons and try again.
  • When you pass, you see the explanation for every question.
  • Used both attempts without passing? Re-watch the lessons, then ask us to reset your quiz with the button below. Please give your licence key (or access code) so we can find your record.

Ask for a quiz reset

Your certificate

  • After you pass, open Certificate of completion on the course page.
  • Type your name exactly as it should appear, for example for your employer or the site’s training records. Check the spelling: the name cannot be changed once the certificate is issued.
  • Download the certificate as a PDF. You can download it again from the course page at any time.
  • Each certificate has its own certificate number (for example FRQ-SI-2026-XXXX-XXXX) and a check link printed on it.

The certificate records that you completed the Field Ready QHSE course and passed its final quiz. It is not a regulated qualification, a licence or a site card, and it does not replace the site-specific induction your site gives you.

Check a certificate

Employers, site managers and auditors can check any certificate on the {VERIFY_LINE}. Enter the certificate number (the last two blocks never use the characters O, 0, I or 1, so they can’t be mixed up). For a valid certificate the page shows the name, course, date of issue and final quiz score. Otherwise it says that no valid certificate was found, for example after a typing error or when a certificate was withdrawn after a refund. No other details about the learner are shown.

Sign-in problems

  • “We could not find that licence key”: copy the key again from your receipt email or Gumroad library and paste it with no spaces before or after it. Pre-25-November buyers: use the access code we sent you.
  • “This licence key was bought with a different email address”: use the email address on your Gumroad receipt, not a work alias or another address.
  • “This purchase was refunded”: a refunded course can no longer be opened.
  • “We could not check your key just now”: the key check service is busy. Wait a few minutes and try again.
  • “Too many attempts today”: after many failed sign-ins from one connection, sign-in pauses until the next day. This protects your key from guessing.
  • Video won’t play: refresh the page (video links renew themselves), switch to Low data or try another browser. Company networks sometimes block video: try your phone’s mobile data.

Report a sign-in or video problem

Ask us

Each button above opens an email with the details we need already listed. Please never send card or bank details.

pages.title: Licence
pages.html:
When you buy a Field Ready QHSE pack, you get a licence to use the files. You don't buy the copyright, which stays with Field Ready QHSE.

Single-organisation licence

  • Use, edit and brand the files inside your own organisation, on all its sites and projects.
  • Print and share the completed documents with your workers, subcontractors, clients and auditors as part of running your work.
  • Keep using the files for as long as you like.

What you can't do

  • Resell, share, give away or publish the editable files, or edited versions of them, as templates or products.
  • Upload them to template sites, marketplaces or shared libraries outside your organisation.

Consultants and multi-company use

To use a pack with several client companies, email {EMAIL} for a multi-company licence.

No warranty

The packs are editable templates. A competent person must check every document against your site, your people and the law where you work before it is used. Field Ready QHSE is not affiliated with ISO or any regulator; standards are referred to by clause number only, and you need your own copy of any standard.

Last updated: {UPDATED}.

pages.title: Refund policy
pages.html:
Our packs are digital downloads that you can open and use as soon as payment goes through.

When we refund

  • A file is missing, damaged or won't open: email us within 30 days of purchase and you get a refund.
  • You were charged twice for the same pack.
  • The pack is clearly different from its description.

Problems we fix

If you report a problem with a file, we fix it and send you the corrected file within 5 working days.

How to ask

Email {EMAIL} within 30 days of purchase with your Gumroad receipt or order number. Approved refunds are paid by Gumroad to your original payment method.

Your right to cancel

When you buy, you ask for the download to start straight away. Under EU consumer rules for digital content, the 14-day right to cancel ends once the download has started. This does not affect the refunds above.

Last updated: {UPDATED}.

pages.title: Frequently asked questions
pages.html:
Which software do I need?

Microsoft Office or a compatible app that opens DOCX, XLSX and PPTX files. PDFs are included where shown on the product page. Each product page lists the formats inside.

How do I get my files?

Straight after payment Gumroad shows your download link and emails it to you with your receipt.

Who handles payment and VAT?

Gumroad is our reseller and merchant of record. It takes the payment, adds the VAT or sales tax for your country at checkout and issues your receipt. Prices on this site exclude VAT.

Can I add my own logo?

Yes. The files are editable, so you can add your logo, site details and procedures.

Can I use a pack on all my sites?

Yes, inside your own organisation. See the licence.

What is the difference between Standard and Premium?

Where a pack comes in two editions, the product page shows what each one includes. Pick the edition with the selector above the buy button.

What if a file is missing or won't open?

Email {EMAIL}. See the refund policy.

pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.html:
Who we are

{SELLER} is the controller responsible for the personal data described here. Seller details are on our seller information page. Contact: {EMAIL}.

What we collect

  • When you buy: Gumroad collects your name, email, billing country and payment details as merchant of record, and shares your email and order details with us so we can support your order.
  • When you use the Course Room (video courses): we check your email address and licence key with Gumroad when you sign in, but do not store them. The Course Room keeps your lesson progress, quiz attempts and answers, and certificate under a one-way code made from your licence key, plus the name you type for your certificate. For access codes we store only one-way codes of the code and your email address. To stop people guessing keys, it counts failed sign-ins per internet address per day. It sets one strictly necessary sign-in cookie (7 days) and saves your progress in your browser. Anyone with your certificate number can see the name, course, date and score on the certificate check page.
  • When you email us: your email address and message.

What we don't do

This website sets no advertising or tracking cookies, loads its fonts from our own server and does not sell your data. When you open the Gumroad checkout, Gumroad's own privacy and cookie policy applies.

How long we keep it

Order records are kept as long as tax law requires. Email enquiries are kept for 24 months. Course Room records are kept while the course is available to you, so you can come back to it and so certificates can be checked; ask us and we delete them.

Your rights

Under the GDPR you can ask to see, correct, delete or export your data, or object to how we use it. Email {EMAIL}. You can also complain to your data protection authority (in Portugal: CNPD).

Last updated: 25 November 2026.
